requirement: Input line ranges must be one-based, inclusive, ordered, and within the file’s lines; an empty file must have no selectable lines.
justification: Scenarios: first/last line, one line, final line without newline, empty file, zero bounds, reversed bounds, and out-of-file bounds including maximum usize. lines checks bounds before slicing split_inclusive lines. Tests assert exact valid slices and reject invalid selections. Validated with cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path language-lab-ci/Cargo.toml (20 tests passing). Each cited test uses isolated fixture files and asserts outcomes, not merely the presence of instructions. Reviewed the cited assertions after the test edit: their code is byte-identical; only line positions moved, with no behavioral change. All 21 checker tests passed with cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path language-lab-ci/Cargo.toml.
